### Item 1 — what the user expresses and how the simulator behaves

- Target object: the Cash Rewards Visa ending 7318 ("you want to use my cash back to pay down my card balance, right now on this call, and if it happens to cover the whole balance, even better").
- Timing: now, on this call. Authorisation mode: "You are glad to approve or click through anything the agent sends you yourself" — she will run any customer-side tool handed over.
- Identity: gives mobile 3365550166 up front; on request DOB 1987-03-19 and SSN last4 6427 (ZIP / email only if still needed). Tool: `verify_customer_identity(... phone, dob, ssn_last4)` → "Identity verified ... (3 detail(s) matched this attempt)".
- She does not know balance or points ("they will have to look that up").
- Conditional (passive) responses only: if told the checking is overdrawn and points must go there first → "put enough of the points into my checking to cover it"; names Everyday Checking ending 6092 if asked. If told a fee is being taken off → thanks, does not argue the kind. Leftover points → "leave whatever is left on the card"; autopay → "leave it the way it is". She never raises the late fee or the overdraft herself.

### Item 2 — act now / wait / refuse, and visible eligibility grounds

Act now, all synchronous. Grounds:
- Card `d5ece847-…` status `active`, days_past_due 4 → redemption allowed (rewards_redemption_and_forfeiture: "Redemption is allowed only while the account is active"); forfeiture threshold for Cash Rewards Visa is 60 days past due (rewards_redemption_values_and_forfeiture_terms) — not reached.
- Paying down with points is a published policy (paying_card_balance_with_points: "a cardholder asks to use rewards points to pay down a card's balance … the points are redeemed as a statement credit on that same card").
- No wait condition appears in any governing document; the tool docs describe immediate postings.

### Item 3 — narrowest objects, keys, included/excluded rows

- Customer `7b65ca78-f68c-4652-b5db-c857180c5e56` (find_customers by phone).
- Card `d5ece847-a637-4240-966b-d1f4e6f314cf` (Cash Rewards Visa, last4 7318, current_balance 276.42, rewards_balance 31453, last_statement_date 2026-08-17, last_statement_balance 154.02, minimum_payment_due 35.00, payment_due_date 2026-09-11, autopay_option statement_balance, autopay_source_account_id `df4449dd-…`).
- Autopay source / only checking: `df4449dd-6c4c-4675-8cd7-20ffcc1527e9`, Everyday Checking, last4 6092, status active, ledger_balance -64.18, negative_since_date 2026-09-13. No savings accounts, no disputes, no card requests.
- Late fee row: `7531336e-b083-48a3-b453-170d908e9804`, card_fee, fee_code late_payment, 32.00, posted 2026-09-12, statement_cycle 2026-08. No fee-reversal row exists on the card. It is the only fee row on the ledger.
- Card payments: last one posted 2026-08-11 (214.72); none posted on 2026-09-11. Ledger recomputed from find_card_transactions: purchases − payments − merchant credit + fee = 276.42 (equals current_balance); points earn 32203 − forfeit 750 = 31453 (equals rewards_balance).
- Excluded: the 2025-11-14 rewards forfeiture (merchant-credit clawback) is already inside the ledger count; no other fees/interest to consider.

### Item 4 — each scored parameter in words

(a) Late fee reversal ground and amount.
- Fee examined (late_fee_examined_for_autopay_ground): late fee posted less than one whole calendar month before the handling date (2026-09-15) and unreversed → fee 7531336e (posted 2026-09-12); count 1 − 0 = 1.
- Autopay covers minimum (autopay_amount_covering_minimum_due): instruction statement_balance → "A minimum due or a statement balance instruction would have debited at least the minimum due" → holds.
- Source on due date (autopay_source_checking_on_due_date): source df4449dd is an active checking of the cardholder; due date examined = due date of most recent statement = 2026-09-11; negative_since 2026-09-13 is later than 2026-09-11 → "not overdrawn on the due date" → holds.
- No payment on due date (payment_posted_on_due_date_check): zero card payments posted 2026-09-11 → holds.
- Combine (autopay_late_fee_bank_error_decision): all hold → bank error ground; courtesy allowance "neither used nor consulted".
- Amount: full fee (autopay_late_fee_reversal_ground: "a reversal is always for the full amount of the fee") = 32.00; adjustment_reason `bank_error`.

(b) Restoring deposit to the overdrawn autopay source.
- Overdrawn amount (overdrawn_autopay_source_shortfall): ledger balance of the card's named autopay source at handling time, as positive → 64.18.
- Points needed (points_needed_to_restore_shortfall): 64.18 / 0.01 (Cash Rewards Visa cash value per point, rewards_redemption_values_and_forfeiture_terms) = 6418 exactly, stays 6418.
- Points open on card (unredeemed_points_for_source_restoration): 31453.
- Size (restoration_redemption_size): target = max(6418, smallest redemption 2500) = 6418; 31453 ≥ target → redeem 6418; cash value 6418 × 0.01 = 64.18.
- Receiving account: the card's autopay source df4449dd (overdrawn_autopay_source_points_restoration: "into that same checking account").

(c) Points statement credit.
- Amount to pay (card_balance_covered_by_points): current amount owed at handling time after the bank-error reversal = 276.42 − 32.00 = 244.42; points that cover it = 244.42 / 0.01 = 24442 (whole).
- Available points (unredeemed_points_for_balance_payoff): ledger at handling time including the restoration posted earlier in the same handling = 31453 − 6418 = 25035.
- Points applied (active_checking_and_points_applied): cardholder holds an active PCB checking (df4449dd) → lesser of 25035 and 24442 = 24442.
- Threshold (balance_payoff_statement_credit_threshold): balance > 0 and 24442 ≥ 2500 → credit made; amount 24442 × 0.01 = 244.42 (half-up, exact).
- Result: card balance 0.00, 593 points left on the card.

### Item 6 — problem tree walked from the visible documents alone

Root: "pay down card balance with points" → apply_points_to_card_balance_295c0528.

- Hop A (root ← restoration). paying_card_balance_with_points, Entry condition: "An overdrawn autopay source checking account has already received its restoring deposit redemption before any points are applied to the card balance. Where the card's autopay source checking account is overdrawn and that condition is unmet, no points are applied to the card balance." Query: find_card_accounts → autopay_source_account_id df4449dd; find_checking_accounts → ledger_balance -64.18 → overdrawn, condition unmet. Which action makes it hold: overdrawn_autopay_source_points_restoration ("points are redeemed first as a deposit into that same checking account, to bring it back to zero"; tool restore_overdrawn_checking_with_points_4e4b44ef, customer-side). Recursing on the restoration: its governing docs (shortfall, points needed, restoration size, points open) contain no entry condition of their own; the card is active (redemption allowed). Leaf.
- Hop B (root ← late-fee reversal). card_balance_covered_by_points, Entry condition: "Every late payment fee on the card that was billed contrary to the charter has been reversed before the rewards statement credit is sized. … Where that condition is unmet, the statement credit is not sized." Query: find_card_transactions → late fee 7531336e 32.00 posted 2026-09-12, no reversal. Is it "billed contrary to the charter"? The card carried autopay, so autopay_late_fee_reversal_ground + the four test docs apply (see item 4a): all conditions hold → bank error, i.e. billed contrary to the charter (autopay_late_fee_bank_error_decision: "a fee that meets the whole test was billed contrary to the charter, and its ground is bank error"). Condition unmet → action: reverse_autopay_late_fee_e77f172c (agent). Recursing: the reversal's docs carry no entry condition. Leaf.
- Resulting problem list: {P1 reverse late fee on bank_error; P2 restore overdrawn autopay source with points; P3 apply points as statement credit}. Edges: P1 → P3 (sizing), P2 → P3 (entry). No edge between P1 and P2. Handling order: P1 and P2 in either order, then P3.
- Counter-proof against "do only what the customer asked": the Entry condition sentences above (paying_card_balance_with_points and card_balance_covered_by_points) are visible clauses that forbid applying/sizing the statement credit while either condition is unmet; so "apply 27642 → all 31453-available … just pay down" is excluded.
- Aggregation check (visible): no visible document lists P1, P2, P3 together as a route; each entry condition is carried only in the bearing document of the blocked problem.

### Two-way counter-proof — closest alternatives excluded

- Courtesy waiver ground instead of bank_error: excluded by autopay_late_fee_bank_error_decision ("Wrong: a fee that meets the whole test may be reversed as a courtesy instead. Correct: … its ground is bank error") and the tool enum text ("courtesy_waiver (the fee was billed correctly …)").
- Sizing on 276.42 (27642 points needed → all 25035 applied, 250.35 credit, 26.07 left): excluded by card_balance_covered_by_points Entry condition and its Wrong/Correct line.
- Applying all unredeemed points (25035, credit balance): excluded by active_checking_and_points_applied branch 1 (active checking held).
- Restoring into another account / skipping restoration: excluded by overdrawn_autopay_source_shortfall ("the account examined is the one named as this card's autopay source") and the Entry condition. Only one checking exists.
- Points needed rounding: quotient 6418 whole → stays (points_needed_to_restore_shortfall "A whole quotient … stays as it is").
- Due-date overdraft alternative (treating the current overdraft as due-date overdraft): excluded by autopay_source_checking_on_due_date table ("29 June, later than the due date → no"); negative_since 2026-09-13 > due 2026-09-11.
- Using the late fee's cycle (2026-08) due date vs another: "The due date examined is the payment due date of the card's most recent statement" → 2026-09-11.

### Visible-surface observations recorded before reveal (to be adjudicated in gt_comparison)

- O1 (tool effect). After the dry-run restoration, find_checking_accounts still returns df4449dd with ledger_balance -64.18 and negative_since_date 2026-09-13: the user tool writes only the card-side redemption entry. The visible KB frames the entry condition as "has already received its restoring deposit redemption", which is checkable from the card ledger, so the path is still walkable; but the tool description's phrase "a cash deposit into one of the cardholder's … checking accounts" is not reflected on the checking record returned by the share finder.
- O2 (retired surface). rewards_redemption_and_forfeiture says the clause listing "a deposit to a PCB checking or savings account" among redemption ways is "no longer in force … superseded by the current basis for cashing out the points of a card that is being closed", while rewards_redemption_values_and_forfeiture_terms still lists "deposit to checking, deposit to savings" among the Cash Rewards Visa's ways. The restoration here is a deposit on a card not being closed; it is authorised by its own document (overdrawn_autopay_source_points_restoration), so the blind answer is not changed, but the visible corpus is not fully consistent about whether a deposit is still a general redemption way.

Blind verdict (pre-reveal): the visible materials yield a unique solution: bank_error reversal 32.00 of fee 7531336e; restoration 6418 points / 64.18 to df4449dd; statement credit 24442 points / 244.42.
